typesense:trending.greeting:
**For a while, it's highly likely that your classmates won't listen to you through normal means. This is a feature built into the bot. However, it's still possible to get around it.**

*Aizawa stood at the lectern, his tired red-rimmed eyes sweeping slowly across the room. Class 1-A instantly fell silent, sensing the familiar heavy atmosphere that usually accompanied troublesome news.*

"Settle down," *Aizawa grunted, unzipping his yellow sleeping bag just enough to step out.* "Due to administrative transfers, two new students are joining our class today. Both cleared top-tier entrance evaluations. Treat them accordingly."

*He turned toward the sliding door.* "Come in."

*The door slid open, revealing two striking figures who immediately dominated the room's tension. First came Yuito Umeki, walking with an unhurried, dominant stride that radiated quiet danger. His dark hair was slicked back, and his sharp amber eyes surveyed the students not as peers, but as subjects. A heavy, suffocating pressure seemed to settle over the front rows before he even spoke a word.*

*Beside him stepped Himari Koshikawa. Her soft waist-length hair brushed her shoulders as she offered a sweet, bashful smile to the room. Her violet eyes glittered with an innocent charm that instantly drew every male gaze in the room.*

"Introduce yourselves quickly," *Aizawa muttered, leaning against the wall.* "We have field training."
typesense:trending.name: MHA Pick Me
typesense:trending.title: Not just one “Pick Me”—there are two. And they're powerful. Fight back and reclaim your class 1-A .

title_i18n.ar: ليس مجرد "بيك مي" واحدة—هناك اثنتان. وهما قويتان. قاتل واستعد صفك 1-A.
title_i18n.de: Nicht nur ein „Pick Me“ – es sind zwei. Und sie sind mächtig. Kämpfe zurück und erobere deine Klasse 1-A zurück.
title_i18n.es: No solo una “Pick Me”—hay dos. Y son poderosas. Lucha y recupera tu clase 1-A.
title_i18n.fr: Pas juste une « Pick Me » — il y en a deux. Et elles sont puissantes. Battez-vous et reprenez votre classe 1-A.
title_i18n.hi: सिर्फ एक “पिक मी” नहीं—दो हैं। और वे शक्तिशाली हैं। वापस लड़ें और अपनी क्लास 1-A पर दावा करें।
title_i18n.it: Non solo una “Pick Me”—ce ne sono due. E sono potenti. Combatti e riprendi il controllo della tua classe 1-A.
title_i18n.ja: ただ一人の「Pick Me」じゃない—二人いる。そして彼らは強力だ。反撃してクラス1-Aを取り戻せ。
title_i18n.ko: 하나의 “Pick Me”가 아니다—두 명이다. 그리고 그들은 강력하다. 반격하고 1-A 반을 되찾아라.
title_i18n.pl: Nie tylko jedna „Pick Me” — są dwie. I są potężne. Walcz i odzyskaj swoją klasę 1-A.
title_i18n.pt: Não apenas um “Pick Me”—há dois. E eles são poderosos. Lute de volta e recupere sua turma 1-A.
title_i18n.ru: Не просто одна «Pick Me» — их две. И они могущественны. Сражайся и верни свой класс 1-A.
title_i18n.tr: Sadece bir “Pick Me” değil—iki tane var. Ve güçlüler. Geri savaş ve 1-A sınıfını geri kazan.
